profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Bosch North America
profile.summary:
Embedded software/Firmware Engineer with 14 years of experience.

- Expert in C/C++ Language.
- Python
- Architect and design Test automation frameworks to early discovery of new product issues.
- Great skills to learn new concepts and to adopt new languages or technologies.
- Delivered great quality products to the market.

Experience with:
- Automotive Clusters
- USB/Bluetooth/DECT Headsets
- Sensors
- Test automation
- Real time Engine Interfaces
- Marine electronic Instruments
- Marine Multifunctional displays
- USB Protocol
- Instruments clusters (Automotive industry)
- NMEA2000/CAN protocol

Have worked with 8 bit (low resources) and 32 bits platforms, delivering code with excelent performance.

Specialties: embedded software, Firmware, real time os, multithreading.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development, customer facing, coordinate development efforts with locations in Germany, India, Portugal and Mexico.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Overall: Design and implementation for instrument clusters (automotive industry).

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Overall: Design and develop firmware for plantronics headsets with bluetooth, usb and DECT technologies.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Software Design engineer at Navico R&D. Software for embedded platforms with NMEA2000 network over CAN.
